description: This is a shell script used for managing and configuring wireless interfaces, hostapd services, bridge interfaces, DHCP settings, and related network configurations on a router or embedded device. It contains functions to restart hostapd for 2G and 5G bands, modify configuration files, enable/disable SSIDs, and manage network interfaces dynamically.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd
methods.description: Stops and restarts the hostapd service for the 2G wireless interface, including killing processes and bringing interfaces up or down.

methods.name: Restart_Hostapd_5G
methods.description: Reloads kernel modules and restarts hostapd for the 5G wireless interface.

methods.name: Hostapd_Restart
methods.description: Kills existing hostapd processes and restarts the service on wlan0 interface.
